description: What an app's users praise and complain about, from the AI tags on its reviews: top issues (topics behind negative, bug, crash, UX and pricing reviews) with last-30-days vs previous-30-days counts and sample reviews, topics, what each recent version changed in rating, sentiment and topics, and weekly sentiment. Use it for "what do users complain about since v2.3?" before reading individual reviews with get_reviews. Cost: 25 credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

country.description: One storefront; omit for every storefront we hold reviews for.

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

since_days.description: How many days of reviews to analyse, 7–730 (default 180).

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

versions.description: How many of the latest versions to break down. Default: 6.

name: get_insights
title: Get Review Insights
